items.title: Karnataka Plans Mobile Museum Showcasing Western Ghats Biodiversity
items.snippet: Karnataka is planning to introduce a mobile museum dedicated to showcasing the unique biodiversity of the Western Ghats, with a specially designed Volvo bus travelling across the state to reach different sections of society.

items.title: Mumbai Airport Plans International Flight Shift to Navi Mumbai
items.snippet: Mumbai International Airport Limited (MIAL) has proposed temporarily relocating all international flights connecting Mumbai with 14 destinations to Navi Mumbai International Airport if airlines do not voluntarily submit their shifting plans.

items.title: Airbnb Sells IP to AI Lab Owned by Its CEO and CTO
items.snippet: Skift Take: Airbnb’s CEO and CTO both own part of the lab buying its IP, but the filing gives shareholders little detail on what changed hands. Airbnb sold intellectual property to a private AI lab founded and controlled by CEO Brian Chesky. CTO Ahmad Al-Dahle also holds a stake in the lab, and both executives work for the entity.

items.title: Coca-Cola's India bottler Hindustan Coca-Cola files for IPO
items.snippet: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, India's largest Coca-Cola bottler, has filed for an initial public offering consisting entirely of a stake sale by its majority shareholder, with no fresh money going to the company, draft papers showed.

items.snippet: As chairman of Savile Row Bespoke Association, Taj Phull knows how to travel in style.

items.title: FDA suspends 105 food business licences, Blinkit, Zepto among them; orders closure of 7 outlets
items.snippet: Maharashtra FDA has suspended the licences of 105 food outlets, including those linked to Blinkit and Zepto, and ordered seven establishments to shut following inspections ahead of Diwali. The two-day drive uncovered hygiene and food safety violations, leading to the seizure of 39,485 kg of food articles worth Rs 1.35 crore.

items.title: Dusit Hotels and Resorts opens two distinctive hotels in Yangon, Myanmar
items.snippet: Dusit Hotels and Resorts, the hotel arm of Thailand-based Dusit International, has officially opened two properties in Yangon, Myanmar, under its management. The Strand Hotel Yangon – Dusit Collection and ASAI Yangon Sule offer distinct hospitality experiences, combining heritage luxury and contemporary lifestyle accommodation with the group’s Thai-inspired hospitality.

items.title: Embergrove Hospitality Group to Manage Historic Hotel Pattee in Perry, Iowa
items.snippet: Embergrove Hospitality Group, which also manages Frank Lloyd Wright's Historic Park Inn, takes over Hotel Pattee on December 1 in a partnership with the City of Perry.

items.title: Korea Tourism Organization, New Delhi Office Hosts Successful Roadshow 2026 in Ahmedabad and Mumbai
items.snippet: The Korea Tourism Organization (KTO) New Delhi Office successfully hosted the Korea Tourism Roadshow 2026 in Ahmedabad on 28th October and Mumbai on 4th November, bringing together key stakeholders from India’s travel trade and tourism industry to explore new business opportunities and strengthen tourism ties between India and South Korea.
